zh.caption: 圖 3｜相近功能，兩種資訊安排
zh.description: A／B 是平行比較，沒有先後箭頭。此為說明性草圖，沒有可操作功能，也尚未經使用者測試。

items.title: 安排 A｜所有事情都很重要
items.body:
管理系統

進階設定
下載報告
查看結果
開始檢查

狀態：INVALID

資料、說明、紀錄、診斷、輸出混在一起。

問題：使用者不清楚現在該做哪件事。

items.title: 安排 B｜依照工作任務呈現
items.body:
申請資料檢查

請確認三項必要資料。

申請編號：A1024
申請人代號：P008
文件類型：未填寫

尚缺少文件類型

補填文件類型

改善方向：錯誤、修正方式與下一個動作有清楚關聯。

zh.caption: 圖 4｜資料完整性檢查：狀態與主要動作
zh.description: 四列對照可能的狀態及動作，不是保證依序發生的四步。完整性檢查通過不代表正式審核或核准。

items.title: 尚未檢查
items.body: 使用者需要確認輸入內容，主要動作是「檢查資料」。

items.title: 檢查中
items.body: 顯示檢查進度，避免重複提交，並說明目前正在處理。

items.title: 發現缺件
items.body: 明確指出缺少什麼，主要動作改為「補填資料並重新檢查」。

items.title: 完整性檢查通過
items.body: 顯示當次檢查結果，必要時才提供「預覽」與「匯出報告」。

zh.caption: 圖 5｜版型改變，閱讀順序保持一致
zh.description: 桌面把 2／3 並排，手機改成上下排列；兩者都依 1→2→3→4 閱讀。數字表示有意義的資訊順序，不是四次實際提交。

en.caption: Figure 3 | Similar functions, two information arrangements
en.description: A and B are alternatives with no sequence arrows. These are explanatory sketches, with no working controls or user-test evidence.

items.title: Arrangement A | Everything is important
items.body:
Management system

Advanced settings
Download report
View results
Start check

Status: INVALID

Data, instructions, records, diagnostics and output are mixed together.

Problem: users cannot identify what to do now.

items.title: Arrangement B | Organize around the task
items.body:
Application-data check

Confirm the three required fields.

Application ID: A1024
Applicant code: P008
Document type: not entered

Document type is missing

Enter document type

Improvement: the error, correction and next action have a clear relationship.

en.caption: Figure 4 | Completeness-check states and primary actions
en.description: The four rows associate possible states with actions, not four steps that must always occur. Completeness does not establish formal review or approval.

items.title: Not checked
items.body: Confirm the inputs. The primary action is Check data.

items.title: Checking
items.body: Show progress, prevent duplicate submission and explain that processing is underway.

items.title: Missing information
items.body: Identify the omission. The primary action becomes Fill in missing data and check again.

items.title: Completeness check passed
items.body: Show the result for this check. Offer Preview and Export report when needed.

en.caption: Figure 5 | Change the layout while preserving reading order
en.description: Desktop places 2 and 3 side by side; mobile stacks them. Both retain reading order 1→2→3→4. Numbers represent information order, not four actual submissions.

en.caption: Figure 6 | From user tasks to a testable interface
en.description: Arrows indicate the suggested order of design work. Step five includes validation; drawing a wireframe does not establish acceptance by real users.

items.title: Define users and tasks
items.body: Who will use it? What are they trying to accomplish?

items.title: Inventory content and functions

items.title: Build IA: categories, names and relationships
items.body: Which information belongs together?

items.title: Define states, navigation and visual hierarchy
items.body: What should users notice and do in each state?

items.title: Draw and validate a wireframe
items.body: Check desktop, mobile, keyboard use and real work tasks.
